entries.name: Decline Push-Up
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft. Feet up on a bench and hands on the floor with the arms straight; the body is one line from the ankles to the head that pivots about the feet as the elbows bend, lowering the chest to just above the floor, and presses back to straight arms. The feet stay on the bench and the hands stay where they are throughout. Not drawn: the hand width, which a side view cannot show.
entries.summary: Feet up on a bench and hands on the floor, lower the chest to just above the floor with the body in one straight line, then press back up until the arms are straight.

frames.caption: Place the hands on the floor a little wider than the shoulders and the feet up on a bench, arms straight and the body in one line.
Bend the elbows to lower the chest until it is just above the floor.
Body in one straight line. Chest just above the floor.
Press back up until the arms are straight.
